# FR-008 — fallback-marked sessions excluded from measurement

**Feature**: 012-sandbox-verifier-honesty · **Task**: T022
**Generated by**: `backend/tests/test_generation_stage_measurement.py`

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sessions in the measured population | **32** |
| Eligible (verification did not use a fallback) | **32** |
| **Excluded (verification used a fallback)** | **0** |

## How the filter works

A session is excluded when its verification result carries `fallback_used = True`,
**regardless of terminal state**. Permissive mode (`ALLOW_HERMETIC_FALLBACK=true`)
lets a substituted verification reach the verified state, so the terminal state
cannot be the discriminator — only the marking can.

## Why the excluded count is currently zero

This harness drives the generation stages, not the sandbox verifier, so its
sessions never carry a verification marking and none is excluded today.

**The filter is therefore not yet load-bearing here — but it is not vacuous.** It
becomes so the moment this harness drives verification, and the failure mode it
prevents is silent: a status-based filter would count a permissive-mode session as
verified and quietly inflate every figure computed from this population.

## Consumer obligation (FR-008)

Any consumer publishing a compliance, quality, intervention-rate, or cost figure
MUST apply this filter and MUST record the excluded count alongside the figure.
